title: Decision: draft-mahy-mimi-av-metadata-02 is adopt-later for mimid (cheap, with JMAP attachments)
description:
Assay mimid-1wgh.44.18 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mimi-av-metadata-02.txt (336 lines, read whole; sha256 in specs/PROVENANCE).

What it is: a MIMI content extension (suggested key 6; free: draft-mimi-content-more-extensions-01 uses 3, 4, 5, 256) carrying per-part rendering hints: part index, media kind (audio 1, image 2, video 3), width, height, duration (ms), preview part, accessibility text, rotation (§3, CDDL). Informational (L7).

How it meets mimid: mimi-content keeps unknown extensions as opaque keys and values (crates/mimi-content/src/extension.rs; decode.rs), so messages carrying it already pass through intact. No conflict.

RECOMMEND: adopt later, when mimid's JMAP projection handles attachments with dimensions: then (1) mimi-content: typed codec for key 6 (part_index must name a SinglePart or ExternalPart, content-10 part index §L751-754); (2) JMAP projection: width, height, duration and alt text onto the attachment fields. Small. Spec defects: wg bead.
